summary: Warm Springs tribal lookout on Shitike Butte: a 90-foot tower, staffed, with access limited by tribal rules. Build year is 1935 in some sources and 1955 in the Register.

access.note: Register: access is limited by Warm Springs Tribe regulations. Cherylhill: not accessible to the public (reservation land). No source describes a public route.

events.note: Annual forestry report for FY1936 (quoted by Weebly): two lookouts completed in fall 1935, one an 80-foot steel tower on Shitike Butte. FireLookout.com and Cherylhill also give 1935.
FireLookout.com lists a known lookout for 1950
Register build year for the current 90-foot Aermotor tower; the Register's 51 years of service as of 2006 points to the same date
Tower renovated with new windows, steps, walls, ceilings and paneling; living quarters remodeled
Biddle Pass Fire (lightning starts July 12). Weebly quotes The Oregonian (August 11, 2007): the lookout was the only structure threatened.

corrections.why: The Register and FireLookout.com both describe a 90-foot tower; 90 feet is 27.4 m. No source gives 2.1 m.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Register gives 1955 and says the tower has served for 51 years. The 1936 forestry report, FireLookout.com and Cherylhill give 1935 for an 80-foot or 90-foot steel tower. Both dates are kept as events because the sources may describe different structures on the same butte. The sources do not say whether the 1955 tower replaced the 1935 one.
The 1935 report describes an 80-foot steel tower; the Register and FireLookout.com describe a 90-foot tower. The story gives 90 feet for the structure standing today.

notes_for_editor: Brief's height_m 2.1 is wrong; 90 feet (27.4 m) is in the Register and FireLookout.com, so it is corrected. Build year conflict (1935 vs 1955) is real and unresolved; both are recorded. The 2007 fire entry is a threat, not a damage report, and comes from a history page quoting The Oregonian. The Oregonian article itself was not read. Access level 'permission' follows the Register's tribal-regulation line; the tribe's own visitor rules were not found. Staffing as_of 2026-07 is the Cherylhill directory date, and the FireLookout.com staffing text is undated.
